content.overview: Article 280 provides that the President shall, within two years from the commencement of the Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, constitute a Finance Commission consisting of a Chairman and four other members appointed by the President. Parliament may by law determine qualifications and selection manner. It shall be the duty of the Commission to make recommendations to the President on the distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Union and the States, the allocation among the States of the respective shares, the principles governing grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States from the Consolidated Fund of India, the measures needed to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement resources of panchayats and municipalities on the basis of State Finance Commission recommendations, and any other matter referred by the President in the interest of sound finance. The President causes the recommendations and an explanatory memorandum to be laid before each House of Parliament.
content.glance: Finance Commission every 5 years (or earlier): Chairman + 4 members. Recommends tax distribution, grants-in-aid, and measures for local bodies’ resources. Report laid before Parliament with memorandum.
content.study:
Article 280 Finance Commission:
**Constitution:** President constitutes within 2 years of commencement and every fifth year (or earlier); Chairman + four other members; qualifications/selection as Parliament by law provides.
**Functions — recommendations on:**
1. Distribution of net proceeds of taxes between Union and States.
2. Allocation among States of respective shares of such proceeds.
3. Principles governing grants-in-aid of State revenues from the Consolidated Fund of India.
4. Measures to augment State Consolidated Fund to supplement resources of panchayats/municipalities (on basis of State Finance Commission recommendations).
5. Any other matter referred by the President in the interest of sound finance.
**Report:** President lays recommendations and explanatory memorandum before each House of Parliament.

Examination: 5-year cycle; composition; tax share + grants + local bodies; parliamentary laying.

sections.heading: Constitution and functions
sections.body:
1. Constituted by President every five years (or earlier): Chairman + 4 members.
2. Recommends tax distribution (Union–States and among States), grants-in-aid principles, local-body resource measures, and other referred matters.
3. Recommendations + memorandum laid before each House of Parliament.
